email.body1:
Quinn, saw Replo is leaning hard into AI-based landing pages for the Shopify ecosystem.

Growing inside an ecosystem that big usually means more co-sell and agency-partner accounts than a founding team can cover by hand, and good opportunities go cold before anyone activates them. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously across the partner ecosystem, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Replo's partner ecosystem off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Quinn, quick follow-up for Replo.

As a founding seller, partner-sourced pipeline targets usually climb faster than you can activate agency and Shopify co-sell motions by hand. Most teams don't actually know how much coverage their ecosystem needs to hit the number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through a co-sell pilot playbook and our pipeline model, showing exactly how many partner meetings Replo needs this quarter and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Quinn, last bit of proof for Replo.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Replo's partner reply rate likely compares to other seed-stage e-commerce startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
